content.text: Users report that `iwe find --meta depends=foo` returns no results for bare frontmatter documents, even though those documents have a `depends:` field with `- foo` in their front matter. The same query works for documents with fenced YAML (---) front matter. All tests pass. Diagnose and fix. Ensure cargo test still passes after the fix.

content.text: Updated (130 chars)

Done. Here's the diagnosis and fix:

## Root Cause

In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`, `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` was filtering out lines starting with a space:

```rust
.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))
```

This stripped YAML continuation lines — exactly the lines that represent sequence items like `  - foo` under a key like `depends:`. The resulting metadata block passed to pulldown-cmark was missing those values, so `get_metadata()` returned YAML without the sequence items, and `metadata_matches()` found nothing to match.

Fenced (`---`) frontmatter bypassed `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` entirely (line 31: `if content.starts_with("---") { return Cow::Borrowed(content) }`), so it was never affected.

## Fix

Removed the `.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))` cleaning from both branches (header-only and header+body), preserving the raw header text including indented continuation lines.

All tests pass.
